title: Delete operations are idempotent by contract
content: API CONVENTION: all Store delete operations (Delete, DeleteAllForUser, future bulk deletes) are IDEMPOTENT: deleting something already gone is a silent no-op returning zero/nil, never an error. Pinned by TestDeleteIdempotent in session_test.go. New delete-shaped APIs MUST follow this and add their own idempotence test.
